cases.title: creates a throwaway fixture supplier for this suite to edit

steps.data: Logged in and navigated to Service Providers > Suppliers
Create a supplier via SuppliersPage.createSupplier(buildFakeSupplierData()) so later scenarios never mutate a real, pre-existing supplier

steps.target: Contact Name, Phone Number, Email, Business License Number

steps.expected: "Supplier details updated successfully." banner is shown on the redirected detail page, which displays the new contact name, phone, email, and license number

cases.title: updates a supplier's company name and location

steps.expected: Detail page heading shows the new company name
Suppliers index, searched by the new name, shows a row with the new name and "{state}, United States" location

riskNotes: The Location column is "{state}, {country}", not "{city}, {country}" — verified live, see project_conventions.md.

cases.title: shows a validation error when Company is cleared

steps.expected: "The company name field is required." validation banner is shown
Suppliers index still shows the supplier under its original (unchanged) name

riskNotes: Confirmed live: a failed validation submit does not persist the blank value — the supplier's existing name is left intact.
